SIKAROOF® VERSIWALL GP 2060: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaRoof® VersiWall GP 2060, May 2026, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/sikaroof-versiwallgp2060.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaRoof® VersiWall GP 2060 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2026, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description.
    - SikaRoof® VersiWall GP 2060 is a planting pot that may be mounted onto walls to create green wall facades. Planting pots are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), while fire-rated planting pots are manufactured from modified reinforced thermoplastics, and it has a baffle plate to spread irrigation evenly, an internal reservoir with a wicking system, an overflow outlet that transfers excess water directly to subsequent planting pots below, and holders for an irrigation line.
    - SikaRoof® VersiWall GP 2060 is used in conjunction with SikaRoof® VersiWall GP Panel or a steel wire mesh with its in-built hooks to create a green wall system.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Planting pots are used to create green walls on either internal or external wall facades.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.2.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaRoof® VersiWall GP 2060
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: PLANTING POT FOR WALL MOUNTED LANDSCAPE GREENING
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports. Singapore Green Building Product (Leader) Cert. No.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - BS EN 45545-2: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Reaction to fire (p.2).
    - BS EN 13501-1: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Reaction to fire (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Baffle plate
    - Internal reservoir
    - Wicking system
    - Irrigation line holders
    - Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
    - Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
    - Operates within a wide service temperature range
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Black planting pot
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Dimensions: 200 x 150 x 195 mm
    - Weight: Closed Planting; 93 kg/m²; Spaced Planting; 62 kg/m²
    - Volume: Planting Media Volume; 1.8 L
2.7 Reaction to fire. SikaRoof® VersiWall GP 2060 Tray Set FR
    | Toxicity Emissions | CIT < 0.75 |
    | Smoke Density | s1 |
    | Fire Spread | Class Bfl |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: (BS EN 45545-2)
    Test method printed: (BS EN 13501-1)
    Test method printed: (BS EN 13501-1)
2.8 Service temperature.
    | Non FR | FR |
    | - 30 °C to 80 °C | - 30 °C to 115 °C |
2.9 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: SikaRoof® VersiWall GP 2060 Tray Set; SikaRoof® VersiWall GP 2060 Tray Set FR; Refer to pricelist
    - Shelf life: No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance to the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet.
2.10 Storage conditions. Products must be stored in their original packing, in their original box, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (May 2026, Version 01.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (May 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Limitations and important considerations. For more information, please contact Sika Sales Personnel.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (May 2026, Version 01.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Reaction to fire: Toxicity Emissions | CIT < 0.75; Smoke Density | s1; Fire Spread | Class Bfl; SikaRoof® VersiWall GP 2060 Tray Set FR (BS EN 45545-2) (BS EN 13501-1) (BS EN 13501-1)
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaRoof® VersiWall GP 2060, May 2026, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/j/sikaroof-versiwallgp2060.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
